answer: A Weekly community check-in streak over thirty days verified by moderator confirmations makes identity a record of showing up: every week the applicant signs in, the moderator confirmations go on the public record, and one missed week resets the streak to zero, so the network trusts the account that was there every week, not the one that appeared yesterday. Without this check, a ocean of fresh fake accounts could appear overnight. When the jetty settles over the haven, the streak holds because every week carried its own proof.
